variation.name: NVAD-E-1270-negative_invalid
variation.description: BIR52ProprietorPartnerProfitLossSharingRatio is set to -10 (negative, i.e. -10%) in partner context tc__ctx_p1. Partner 2 is set to 110% so the sum stays 100% and NVAD-E-1280 does not fire. Only the negative-ratio check triggers NVAD-E-1270.
